title: Operate the standing Architecture & Repository Governor
purpose: Maintain the architecture frame, repository integrity, evidence discipline, work-package boundaries, and phase gates across releases and AI-agent cycles.

baseline.selectionRule: The governor function becomes permanent once this work package and its executable state validation are merged.

invariants: The governor distinguishes evidence, claim, assumption, and missing proof.
The operational governor does not become the sole certifier of its own implementation.
The current governance frame has one canonical machine-readable state.
Exceptions are explicit, bounded, owned, and expiring.
The accountable owner retains final product and business authority.
adversarialTests: remove governor state and verify CI fails
set an invalid decision or phase status and verify CI fails
add a held capability to authorized work and verify governance review detects the contradiction
attempt to approve a high-risk package without independent review and verify the governor blocks it
create an exception without owner or expiry and verify it is rejected
nonGoals: govern the active standalone code before it is imported
implement branch protection through documentation alone
create a permanent architecture committee before additional collaborators exist
independentReview: independent QA review of executable governance checks
rollback: Revert the governor bootstrap pull request. Existing architecture and repository documents remain, but no persistent governor authority should be claimed after rollback.
